en.headline: Bug report on openchamber turn-merging, 17 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-10, `sogeisetsu` opened issue #4664 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity", and then commented on the same issue shortly after. The issue remains open. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied with a maintainer note marking the bug as `fix-ready` and tracing the cause to grouping logic in `packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/turns/projectTurnRecords.ts:244-246`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, there were **0 own commits** plus 17 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Totals for the day: 0 commits, 0 PRs, 2 issue actions, 0 reviews.
